title: Figures 9-10: FLIR stills of Tic Tac UAP in White Hot and Black Hot modes
description: Two forward-looking infrared (FLIR) sensor stills from the Navy F/A-18 ATFLIR footage of the 2004 Nimitz 'Tic Tac' encounter. Figure 9 shows the target in 'White Hot' mode as a bright blob in the tracking gate; Figure 10 shows the same object in 'Black Hot' mode as a dark oblong shape, with HUD symbology and sensor readouts visible.
